items.name: Fire-Grilled Steak Bowl
items.description: All-natural fire-grilled steak served warm, roasted butternut squash, crispy brussels sprouts, tangy goat cheese, and creamy garlic herb dressing over wild rice.

items.name: Hot Honey Chicken Bowl
items.description: Warm roasted chicken tossed in hot honey, smoky bacon, shredded cheddar, pickled red onions, and roasted broccoli over wild rice.

items.name: Sweet Chili Shrimp Bowl
items.description: Shrimp, crisp cucumbers, carrots, edamame, crunchy wonton strips,and sweet sesame dressing over wild rice.

items.name: Create Your Own Salad
items.description: Build what works for you! Choose your base, 5 favorite toppings, and dressing. Add protein and premium toppings to truly make it yours!

items.name: Superfood Salad
items.description: Our Saladworks Blend with Grilled Chicken, Quinoa, Goat Cheese, Pickled Onions, Roasted Butternut Squash, Roasted Brussel Sprouts, and Fuji Apple Cider Vinaigrette.

items.name: Kale Caesar Salad
items.description: Our Kale Caesar Salad comes with a base of Romaine/Iceberg Blend and Kale. It is served with Grilled Chicken, Sliced Egg, Parmesan Cheese, Housemade Croutons and Classic Caesar dressing.

items.name: Sophie's Salad
items.description: This Napa-inspired salad comes with a base of our Spring Mix. It is served with Grilled Chicken, Bleu Cheese, Dried Cranberries, Honey Roasted Pecans, Diced Apples and our Lite Raspberry Vinaigrette dressing.

items.name: Roasted Turkey Club Salad
items.description: Our Roasted Turkey Club comes with a base of Romaine/Iceberg Blend and Radiatore Pasta. It is served with Roasted Turkey, Smoky Bacon, Diced Tomatoes and our Housemade Ranch dressing.

items.name: The Family Bundle
items.description:
Choose any four entrées from a selection of fresh salads, wraps, and melts—perfect for feeding a group. Need an option for the little ones? Swap any entrée for a Kids Meal. You can also complete your meal by upgrading with a quart of soup.
Available for online order ahead and delivery only.

items.name: NEW Steakhouse Salad
items.description: Our Saladworks blend with all-natural fire-grilled steak served warm, carrots, roasted red peppers, blue cheese crumbles, crispy onions and creamy garlic herb dressing.

items.name: Southwest Chipotle Ranch Salad
items.description: Our Chef-inspired regional favorite starts with a recommended base of our Romaine/Iceberg Blend. It is served with Grilled Chicken, Fresh Avocado, a Fire-Roasted Corn & Bean Medley, Diced Tomatoes, Pepper Jack Cheese and Tri-Color Tortilla Strips. We recommend our Housemade Chipotle Ranch dressing.

items.name: Tofu Superfood Salad
items.description: Our Saladworks Blend with Tofu, Quinoa, Goat Cheese, Pickled Onions, Roasted Butternut Squash, Roasted Brussel Sprouts, and Fuji Apple Cider Vinaigrette.

items.name: NEW Mediterranean Chicken Salad
items.description: Our Saladworks Blend with Grilled Chicken, Pickled Onions, Crumbled Feta, Artichokes, Cucumbers and Lemon Tahini Vinaigrette.

items.name: Southwest Chicken Caesar Salad
items.description: Our Romaine/Iceberg Blend with All-Natural Warm Roasted Chicken, Parmesan Cheese, Pepitas, Tortilla Strips and Chipotle Caesar Dressing.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
items.description: Our Grilled Chicken Caesar comes recommended with a base of Romaine/Iceberg Blend. It is served with Grilled Chicken, Sliced Egg, Parmesan Cheese and Housemade Croutons. We recommend our Classic Caesar dressing.

items.name: Fuji Apple Crunch Salad
items.description: Our Saladworks Blend with Quinoa, Grilled Chicken, Pickled Onions, Dried Cranberries, Goat Cheese, Apple Chips, and Fuji Apple Cider Vinaigrette.

items.name: Sophie's Salad
items.description: This Napa-inspired Signature starts with a recommended base of our Spring Mix. It is served with Grilled Chicken, Bleu Cheese, Dried Cranberries, Honey Roasted Pecans and Diced Apples. We recommend our Lite Raspberry Vinaigrette dressing.

items.name: Asian Crispy Chicken Salad
items.description: Our Chef recommends a base of our Saladworks Blend. It is served with Sweet Chili Crispy Chicken, Mandarin Oranges, Sliced Cucumbers, Matchstick Carrots, Edamame and Crispy Wonton Strips. We recommend our Sweet Sesame dressing.

items.name: Avocado Cobb Salad
items.description: Fresh Avocado enhances this timeless classic! Start with the recommended base of our Romaine/Iceberg Blend. It is served with Grilled Chicken, Diced Tomatoes, Fresh Avocado, Sliced Egg, Smoky Bacon and Bleu Cheese. We recommend our Thousand Island dressing.

items.name: Bently Salad
items.description: Our Chef recommends a base of our Romaine/Iceberg Blend. It is served with Smoked Ham, Roasted Turkey, Provolone Cheese, Sliced Egg and Diced Tomatoes. We recommend our Green Goddess dressing.

items.name: Smoky BBQ Chicken Salad
items.description: This Chef-inspired Signature starts with a recommended base of Romaine/Iceberg Blend. It is served with Smoky BBQ Crispy Chicken, Diced Tomatoes, Sweet Corn, Cheddar Cheese and Onion Crisps. We recommend our Ranch dressing.

items.name: Buffalo Bleu Salad
items.description: Our Chef recommends a base of our Romaine/Iceberg Blend. It's served with Grilled Buffalo Chicken, Diced Tomatoes, Sliced Banana Peppers, Bleu Cheese and Tri-Color Tortilla Strips. We recommend our Creamy Bleu Cheese dressing.

items.name: Roasted Turkey Club Salad
items.description: Our Roasted Turkey Club starts with a recommended base of Romaine/Iceberg Blend and Radiatore Pasta. It is served with Roasted Turkey, Smoky Bacon and Diced Tomatoes. We recommend our Ranch dressing.

items.name: NEW Steak & Cheddar Melt
items.description: All-natural fire-grilled steak served warm, shredded cheddar cheese, roasted red peppers, and crispy onions on rustic white bread.

items.name: Turkey Cheddar and Bacon
items.description: Roasted Turkey, Crumbled Bacon, Shredded Cheddar, and Thousand Island melted on Rustic White Bread.

items.name: Chipotle Chicken and Bacon
items.description: All-Natural Warm Roasted Chicken, Crumbled Bacon, Shredded Cheddar Cheese, Avocado, and Chipotle Ranch melted on Rustic White Bread.

items.name: Buffalo Chicken
items.description: Buffalo Chicken, Blue Cheese Dressing, and Shredded Mozzarella melted on Rustic White Bread.

items.name: Grilled Cheese
items.description: Shredded Mozzarella and Cheddar Cheese melted between two slices of our Rustic White Bread.

items.name: Chicken Pesto
items.description: Grilled Chicken, Shredded Mozzarella and Cheddar, Diced Tomatoes, and Pesto melted on Rustic White Bread.

items.name: Black & Blue Grilled Wrap
items.description: All-natural fire-grilled steak served warm, blue cheese crumbles, roasted red peppers, crispy onions, spinach, and blue cheese dressing.

items.name: Buffalo Chicken Grilled Wrap
items.description: This grilled wrap includes Buffalo Chicken, Tomatoes, Spinach, Blue Cheese Crumbles and Ranch Dressing.

items.name: Cali Chicken Grilled Wrap
items.description: This grilled wrap includes Grilled Chicken, Avocado, Tomatoes, Spinach, Mozzarella, and our favorite- Green Goddess Dressing on a Flour Wrap!

items.name: Turkey Jalapeno Crunch Grilled Wrap
items.description: This grilled wrap includes Turkey, Tomatoes, Cheddar Cheese, Spinach, Jalapeno Potato chips, and Ranch Dressing on a Flour Wrap!

items.name: Pick 2
items.description: Your choice of any 2 of your favorite entrees! Choose between a half portion of our Signature, Premium or Create Your Own Salads, a small soup, or a half melt.

items.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
items.description: This soup is prepared the old fashioned way, chunks of hearty vegetables and diced chicken slow simmered in a seasoned chicken broth with ribbons of egg pasta.

items.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
items.description: Everyone's favorite soup made with generous pieces of broccoli, creamy sharp Cheddar cheeses and a touch of spice.

items.name: Baked Potato Soup
items.description: We’ve taken a delicious baked potato loaded with all the fixin’s and turned it into a hearty soup by blending potatoes with light cream, uncured bacon, chives and a touch of spice.

items.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
items.description: A unique soup made with tender chicken, flavorful roasted corn, diced tomatoes, Monterey Jack cheese, jalapeno peppers and thickened with tortilla chips.

items.name: Spring Vegetable Soup
items.description: Featuring a bounty of Spring flavors, this delicious medley of vegetables is simmered to perfection in an herbed vegetable stock.

items.name: Sugar Cookie

items.name: Chocolate Fudge Brownie

items.name: Crispy Rice Marshmallow Treat

items.name: 16oz Dressing
items.description: Take your favorite dressings home! Choose from our available flavors below.

items.name: Kids Bento Box
items.description: Building your own meal can be as fun as eating it! You get to choose one item from each of our 5 yummy categories (Proteins/Veggies/Fruits/Grains/Dressings).  All Kids Works menu items are served with a Juice Box.

items.name: Kids Create Your Own Salad
items.description: Encourage originality with a kids-size Create Your Own Salad -- start by customizing your base, choose up to 3 toppings and your dressing. What kind of salad will you create? All Kids Works menu items are served with a Juice Box.

items.name: Kids Grilled Chicken Quesadilla
items.description: Our Grilled Chicken is Panini-pressed with cheese into an ooey-gooey Quesadilla that is highly craveable! It is served with a choice of 1 Veggie and 1 Fruit, and a Dip or Dressing is served on the side. All Kids Works menu items are served with a Juice Box

items.name: Kids Grilled Cheese
items.description: Half portion of our classic Grilled Cheese with Shredded Mozzarella and Cheddar Cheese on our Rustic White Bread. Served with your choice of one veggie and one fruit. Served with a Juice Box.
